newsitem.title: USA: FULL TEXT - OfficeMax in definitive deal.
newsitem.headline: FULL TEXT - OfficeMax in definitive deal.

text.p: Office Max said it signed a definitive deal to acquire 63 Staples/Office Depot shops for $108.75 million.
A full text of the company's press release follows.

CLEVELAND, March 26 /PRNewswire/ -- OfficeMax, Inc. (NYSE: OMX), the Cleveland-based office products superstore chain, today announced that it has signed a definitive agreement with Staples, Inc. (SLPS) and Office Depot, Inc. (ODP) to acquire 63 of their superstores in key major metropolitan markets for approximately $108.75 million.

As previously announced, with this acquisition OfficeMax will gain new market entries with stores in Baltimore, Washington DC, San Diego, Tampa/St. Petersburg and Louisville, KY, together with 14 outlets in the greater Los Angeles area. The Company will also gain locations in 11 other markets.

The transaction is subject to approval by the Federal Trade Commission and conditioned on the sale of the stores to OfficeMax being the predicate for a consent settlement of the Commission's investigation of the proposed merger between Staples and Office Depot, and approval of the merger by stockholders of both companies.

OfficeMax currently operates over 575 superstores in over 225 markets in 48 states, Puerto Rico and Mexico. In addition, the Company operates store- within-a-store modules of FurnitureMax and CopyMax, which are devoted exclusively to office furniture and "print-for-pay" services, respectively. The Company also operates OfficeMax OnLine on the Internet at http://www.officemax.com which enables individual consumers and businesses to buy a wide assortment of OfficeMax merchandise using their personal computers.

This release contains forward-looking statements which are subject to risk and uncertainties. OfficeMax's quarterly report on Form 10-Q for the quarter ended July 27, 1996, contains additional discussion about these factors which could cause results to differ from Management's expectations.
